recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. If a future rendering regression hides Resource profiles again, fix the renderer/publisher path rather than changing the Bundle element types in core source.
issue_request: FHIR-46561 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction asking the tooling to display profiles on elements whose declared type is Resource, using Bundle.issues and Bundle.entry.response.outcome as examples that should show their OperationOutcome restriction.
initial_application: No FHIR source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-46561 was found. The current Bundle source already declares both affected elements as type Resource with profile http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/OperationOutcome, and the current CI-rendered profile displays both type cells as Resource (OperationOutcome).
additional_context: FHIR-46484 is the immediate source-side precursor: it clarified Bundle.issues as an OperationOutcome, added the OperationOutcome profile to Bundle.entry.response.outcome, and said a tooling ticket should correct Resource(OperationOutcome) display. FHIR-14427 records the earlier no-change decision against changing Bundle.entry.response.outcome's declared type from Resource to OperationOutcome. FHIR-I minutes first identified FHIR-46561 as a tooling issue and later recorded it as already applied.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The build-scoped source already contains the relevant profiles and the current rendered build exposes them, satisfying the seed request.
